issues.description: alloc_if_none trusts the parent entry's address, level, root relationship, and resulting child-guard postconditions instead of deriving them from Entry well-formedness.
issues.rationale: The selected revision removes external_body from alloc_if_none but immediately assumes every semantic fact needed to insert the child into the SPT model and later assumes the advertised self.wf, frame level, and change-scope guarantees. The then-current Entry::wf does not constrain the tracked VA alignment, node/root relationship, or modeled frame level, so these are not consequences of the public preconditions. Commit b4c63161 strengthens Entry::wf with those relationships, fixes map_va to use the tracked VA, and replaces the assumptions with checked assertions; the later allocation-freshness/SPT invariant work is tracked separately.
issues.source_evidence: after/lock-protocol/src/mm/page_table/node/entry.rs lines 427-445 constructs an IntermediatePageTableEntryView and assumes its well-formedness plus all parent/root/level facts. Lines 470-474 assume the function's own post-state guarantees. Official repair b4c63161c57b3c4551d0839b06f216743a93aed9 strengthens Entry::wf and changes these statements to assertions.
issues.verification: Fixed-source contract/precondition analysis and direct official repair diff. Historical Verus was not executed.
